items.label: Read the neighborhood
items.text: Introduce the colony, its information displays and distant cargo infrastructure. The pair deliberately notices useful information; approach the criminal depot without openly advertising their partnership.

items.label: Agree to split
items.text: Opening hook establishes the adventure premise and their scheme: Harper will be seen alone while Taffy keeps enough distance to steal unnoticed. The news line is ironic; they pay attention to practical displayed information.

items.label: Attention, theft, separate exits
items.text: Hang back and conceal the partnership; Harper draws criminal eyes onto herself and the jewel. Taffy takes the override key on grab the thing we need. Harper leads attention away via the public passage and disappears; Taffy slips through the screened service exit. Use latest character designs, not the old boy costume on the cover.

items.label: Reunite at the blue pipe
items.text: The first Are you with me checks that the split worked. They rejoin beneath the blue pipe elbow, discreetly confirm the key and move together toward the relay entrance.

items.label: Use the key, enter, discover the news
items.text: Next stop is a different building. We use that / This like that is learning the key-reader fit. Cross the door on walk on in; News reveals an interior broadcast seeking them. Current environment planning stops after this reaction.
items.location: Relay entrance and interior freight hall

items.label: Two questions
items.text: The two post-news Are you with me calls remain in the accepted lyric timing. Continue planning from their joint discovery inside the hall; a second physical separation has not been established by the user. Preserve the accepted with/me boundary at 87.04 seconds.
items.location: Relay hall / continuation not yet planned

items.label: A moment above the crowd
items.text: A warmer pause, a shared view of the port and a small act of care. Show competence and mutual dependence without inventing a detailed rescue flashback.

items.label: The rhythm goes wrong
items.text: A timed maneuver almost works; an error on Missed creates a real complication. Taffy helps recover. Choose the mechanism after the geography is agreed.

items.label: Find another way
items.text: Wordless solo: stealth, climbing and cooperative problem solving. Bring them to an identifiable ship. Seed the eventual forced-landing cause once that cause is chosen.

items.label: The cost becomes visible
items.text: The changed chorus shifts from playful theft to consequence. Their escape window narrows as the racketeer or port control reacts. Keep the pursuit readable rather than adding a new villain.

items.label: A plan that keeps looping
items.text: A repeated start sequence or blocking obstacle reflects the bridge. They break the loop by acting together. Hold a brief human beat instead of continuous control-panel inserts.

items.label: Commit to the attempt
items.text: The last chance to stop becomes their decision to go. Bring both children into the same action, secure loose equipment and establish what they are holding onto.

items.label: Hang on for your life
items.text: Ignition, a shared look and lift-off. The final line opens the escape rather than serving as a disconnected caption.

items.label: Farther, but still here
items.text: Instrumental outro: apparent freedom, a previously seeded failure or interception, forced descent, survivable landing. End on the pair together with the colony still on the horizon. Not a triumphant offworld escape.

items.label: Observe and brief
items.text: Adventure premise and plan to split. They deliberately read useful information. Harper explains the separate roles before presenting herself alone.

items.label: Stay behind; she acts alone
items.text: Harper moves into the public forecourt; Taffy hangs back in screened cover. Criminal associates must not see that they arrived together.

items.label: All attention on Harper
items.text: The jewel presentation catches racketeer, associates and shoulder lookout. Keep their sightlines away from Taffy and the device.

items.label: Take the override key
items.text: Taffy lifts the asymmetric horseshoe device while attention is held elsewhere. Make object identity readable without interrupting the concealment.

items.label: Separate disappearances
items.text: Harper takes the visible public exit and loses pursuit in the lower dogleg. Taffy vanishes along the screened service ledge. Both head to the blue-pipe court.

items.label: Check and reunite
items.text: First refrain: is he there, did it work? A discreet glimpse of the key and reunion under the blue pipe elbow. They leave together.

items.label: A different entrance
items.text: Arrive at a controlled freight/utility entrance beyond the market. This is one step toward the port, not the ship itself.

items.label: Learn the device
items.text: Match and orient the stolen asymmetric device in the door-jamb reader. Proposed action: initial wrong orientation, then turn it to fit. No second theft.

items.label: Cross the threshold
items.text: Use the opened door and enter the relay hall. The wanted display belongs inside, so the reveal follows the access success.

items.label: The broadcast is about them
items.text: They notice the wanted broadcast after entry. News / Big news / I never watch the news carries discovery and reaction. Exact portraits and text are a later controlled overlay.
